guide.bakery.veggies.title: Vegetables
guide.bakery.veggies.text: Corn grows three blocks tall and peas climb a little trellis - right-click a ripe stalk to harvest and it grows back. Pull sweet potatoes and peanuts out by hand. Zucchini spreads like melons.
guide.bakery.special_crops.title: Special Crops
guide.bakery.special_crops.text: Rhubarb, hibiscus and cranberries can be picked again and again. Cranberries need water next to their farmland. Candyfloss only grows at night or in the rain!
guide.bakery.proofing.title: Proofing
guide.bakery.proofing.text: Rest dough in a Proofing Basket until it has risen (about 30 seconds) - but don't forget it or it collapses! Proofed dough gives an extra star when rolled.
guide.bakery.bake_screen.title: Tending the Fire
guide.bakery.bake_screen.text: Right-click the oven to open the Bake screen. Each bake has a favorite heat: keep the needle in the green by fanning the fire or opening the door. Prep + timing + heat = your stars!
guide.bakery.millstone.title: Grand Millstone
guide.bakery.millstone.text: Load the Grand Millstone, then push the crank round with an empty hand. Keep a steady rhythm and the stone turns twice as fast. Flour pours out of the spout.
guide.bakery.millstone_build.title: Building It
guide.bakery.millstone_build.text: 3x3 stone bricks, the Millstone Core in the middle on top, and a cobblestone wall on each side. Tap the core with the spatula.
guide.bakery.fountain.title: Chocolate Fountain
guide.bakery.fountain.text: Melt chocolate bars into it, then dip strawberries, cherries, oranges, peanuts or candyfloss for chocolate treats!
guide.bakery.fountain_build.title: Building It
guide.bakery.fountain_build.text: 3x3 white terracotta, the Fountain Core in the middle on top, and a gold block on the core. Tap it with the spatula.
guide.bakery.juicer.title: Juicer
guide.bakery.juicer.text: Drop a fruit on the juicer and pull the lever five times - watch it squash! Each fruit makes two glasses; fill bottles from the jug.
guide.bakery.churn.title: Ice Cream
guide.bakery.churn.text: Add whipped cream, sugar, ice (and a flavor), then churn twelve times with a steady rhythm. Ice cream melts fast - frost wrap it!
guide.bakery.jam_pot.title: Jam Pot
guide.bakery.jam_pot.text: Put the pot over a campfire, add three of one fruit and sugar, and keep stirring with a whisk while it bubbles. Fill jars when it's done.

guide.bakery.welcome.title: Welcome, Baker!
guide.bakery.welcome.text: This little book will teach you everything: growing pretty ingredients, mixing and rolling dough, baking in a Grand Brick Oven, and running your very own bakery. Turn the page!
guide.bakery.farming.title: Growing Things
guide.bakery.farming.text: Break grass to find seeds: strawberry, blueberry, raspberry, tea, mint, vanilla, lavender, rose, pineapple, and the rare glowing starbloom. Plant them on farmland. Ripe crops can be turned back into seeds.
guide.bakery.trees.title: Fruit Trees
guide.bakery.trees.text: Coconut palms grow on beaches and lemon trees in meadows and plains. Right-click ripe fruit to pick it - it grows back! Their wood makes lovely pastel planks, doors and fences.
guide.bakery.pantry.title: The Pantry
guide.bakery.pantry.text: Flour: 3 wheat. Butter: a milk bucket. Whipped cream: milk + sugar. Chocolate: cocoa, sugar and milk. Matcha: smelt tea leaves. Coconut flakes: crack a coconut.
guide.bakery.mixing.title: Mixing Dough
guide.bakery.mixing.text:
Drop ingredients into a Mixing Bowl, then stir 8 times with a Whisk.
Bread: 2 flour + water
Sweet: flour, egg, sugar, butter
Pastry: 2 flour + 2 butter
Cookie: flour, 2 sugar, butter
Add one fruit or flower to flavor it!
guide.bakery.rolling.title: Rolling Out
guide.bakery.rolling.text: Put dough on a Pastry Board and use a Rolling Pin. Pick what to make, then press SPACE when the pin crosses the gold mark. Five good rolls = five stars to start with.
guide.bakery.oven.title: The Grand Oven
guide.bakery.oven.text: A real oven is built, not crafted! Craft an Oven Heart and a Sweetheart Spatula, gather 21 bricks, and build the shape on the next page.
guide.bakery.oven_build.title: Building It
guide.bakery.oven_build.text: The heart faces you, with an empty space right behind it. Tap the heart with the spatula - pink sparkles show any missing bricks.
guide.bakery.baking.title: Baking
guide.bakery.baking.text: Feed it coal or wood and slide in up to three shaped bakes. A bell rings when they're ready - take them out in the golden window! The spatula switches heat: high is fast but tricky.
guide.bakery.decorating.title: Decorating
guide.bakery.decorating.text: Hold a cupcake, donut, cookies, macarons or cake in your offhand and use a topping on it. Placed cakes can be decorated directly. Every topping adds a star - star petals add two!
guide.bakery.freshness.title: Keeping Fresh
guide.bakery.freshness.text: Food goes stale and eventually moldy. Hold it in your offhand and use Wax Paper (2x), Frost Wrap (3x) or a Glass Jar (5x) to make it last longer. Jams never spoil.
guide.bakery.drinks.title: Drinks
guide.bakery.drinks.text: Craft drinks in a Mug: matcha latte, hot chocolate, strawberry milk, teas, lemonade, coconut milk and a pineapple smoothie. Each gives a little boost, and mugs look sweet on a table.
guide.bakery.shop.title: Your Bakery
guide.bakery.shop.text: Place a Bakery Counter and right-click it to open. Villagers come over and show what they'd like above their heads. Hand it to them before their hearts run out! Ring the Service Bell to call someone.
guide.bakery.reviews.title: Stars & Fame
guide.bakery.reviews.text: Better bakes earn bigger tips in Sweet Coins. Stock a Display Case and customers serve themselves - collect the till by sneak-clicking the counter. Sneak-click any villager with a bake for a review!

sticker.bakery.star_patissier.desc: Become a Star Pâtissier: 50 reviews averaging 4.5 stars.
guide.bakery.sweet_life.title: The Sweet Life
guide.bakery.sweet_life.text: Customers now pay in Sweet Coins. Spend them at the Bakery Catalog on decor, outfits, seeds and kitchen goodies. Decorate cakes, ice cookies, wrap gifts, make villager friends and fill your sticker book!
guide.bakery.progress.title: My Bakery
guide.bakery.progress.all_done: Every sticker collected! You are a true Sweetheart Baker.
guide.bakery.first_day.title: Your First Day
guide.bakery.first_day.text:
1. Place your Bakery Catalog and buy a counter, bowl, board and oven heart.
2. Mix dough, shape it, bake it.
3. Open the counter: your first customer only wants bread or cookies!
4. Every customer helps your bakery grow.
guide.bakery.stickers.title: Sticker Book
guide.bakery.cookies.title: Sugar Cookies
guide.bakery.cookies.text: Put Cookie Dough on a Pastry Board and use a Cookie Cutter on it: heart, star, bunny or flower. Bake the tray in the Grand Oven for four Sugar Cookies.
guide.bakery.icing.title: Icing Cookies
guide.bakery.icing.text: Hold a baked Sugar Cookie in one hand and an Icing Bag in the other, then use the bag. Six pastel colours! Iced cookies get an extra star.
guide.bakery.cake_studio.title: Cake Turntable
guide.bakery.cake_studio.text: Put a cake on the turntable. Click with more cakes to stack up to three tiers, press a Mould to make it square or a heart. Click with an empty hand to spin it round.
guide.bakery.cake_tips.title: Cute Cake Tips
guide.bakery.cake_tips.text: Cuteness hearts come from frosting, piping, lots of toppers, three or more kinds and symmetry (try Mirror!). Candles count too. Cute cakes get bonus stars.
guide.bakery.gifts.title: Gifts
guide.bakery.gifts.text: Hold anything in your other hand and use a Gift Box to wrap it. Give it to a customer once a day: +2 hearts, +3 if it is their favourite flavour.
guide.bakery.coins.title: Sweet Coins
guide.bakery.coins.text: Customers and food critics pay in Sweet Coins. Tips grow with stars, speed, the right flavour, your bakery's Charm and the Sweet Baker outfit.
guide.bakery.catalog.title: Bakery Catalog
guide.bakery.catalog.text: Right-click the Catalog to shop with Sweet Coins. Fancier goodies unlock as your bakery grows. One item each day is the Daily Special.
guide.bakery.charm.title: Charm
guide.bakery.charm.text: Cozy decorations within 6 blocks of a counter give it Charm hearts: plushies, lamps, rugs, furniture, flowers... Charm brings more customers who wait longer and tip more.
guide.bakery.friends.title: Regulars
guide.bakery.friends.text: Every regular has a name, a favourite flavour and one they dislike. 4-5 star service and gifts earn hearts: at 5 they are a regular, at 10 your best friend - with a present!
guide.bakery.wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
guide.bakery.wardrobe.text: Hats go on your head with a right-click: Chef Hat, Strawberry Beret, Bunny Ears, Cat Ears and a Ribbon Bow. The Frilly Apron is worn like a chestplate.
guide.bakery.outfit.title: Sweet Baker
guide.bakery.outfit.text: Wear any bakery hat together with the Frilly Apron and you are a Sweet Baker: every customer tips an extra Sweet Coin.
guide.bakery.decor.title: Pastel Decor
guide.bakery.decor.text: Checker tiles, strawberry, gingham, heart and polka dot wallpaper, heart and cloud rugs and floating heart balloons. Craft them or buy them in the Catalog.
guide.bakery.decor_more.title: Little Touches
guide.bakery.decor_more.text: Fairy Lights and Cupcake Lamps glow, Cookie Jars and Macaron Towers dress up a counter, and striped Awnings make a lovely shop front.
tooltip.bakery.bellows: Puff air into the Grand Oven to make the fire hotter

message.bakery.oven.vent: You open the damper - the fire cools a little
message.bakery.turntable.tall: Three tiers is as tall as it gets!
message.bakery.turntable.full_icing: There is no room left for more icing
message.bakery.turntable.on_top: Toppers go on top of a tier
guide.bakery.cozy_cafe.title: The Cozy Café
guide.bakery.cozy_cafe.text: Everything happens in the world now: watch fruit squash in the juicer, the stone turn, the fire grow. Customers walk in, sit down to eat or take treats home, and your bakery grows a level at a time.
guide.bakery.starter_shopping.title: First Shopping List
guide.bakery.starter_shopping.text: With your 40 coins: a Bakery Counter, Mixing Bowl, Pastry Board, Rolling Pin, an Oven Heart and 16 Bricks, plus Flour, Butter, Sugar and a Water Bucket from the Pantry. Seeds are in the Garden tab.
guide.bakery.tending.title: Tending the Fire
guide.bakery.tending.text: Watch the gauge on the oven: puff the Bellows to heat it, sneak-click to open the damper and cool it. Keep the needle on the green notch. Golden sparkles mean perfect - click the bake to peel it out!
guide.bakery.piping.title: Piping
guide.bakery.piping.text: Click the cake with an Icing Bag to pipe exactly there. Sneak-use the bag to change tips: dots, rosettes, lines (click point to point), a border, drips down the side, or frost a whole tier. Sneak-click to scrape it off.
guide.bakery.toppers.title: Toppers
guide.bakery.toppers.text: Fondant hearts and bunnies, sugar flowers, mini macarons, a golden crown, candles, fruit... click the top of a tier to stand one there. More tiers, shapes, colours and matching pairs = cuter = more stars!
guide.bakery.customers.title: Customers
guide.bakery.customers.text: Regulars walk in, queue at the counter and show what they want. Hand it over! Some take it home, others find a free café chair, eat or drink there and leave a tip on the table.
guide.bakery.levels.title: Growing Your Bakery
guide.bakery.levels.text: Little Stall → Cozy Corner (5 served) → Sweet Café (15) → Pâtisserie (35) → Grand Bakery (70). Each level brings new dishes, more customers and new things in the Catalog.
guide.bakery.menu.title: The Menu Board
guide.bakery.menu.text: Right-click a Menu Board near your counter to choose which dishes customers may order. Only ready for bread today? Untick the rest!
guide.bakery.cozy_decor.title: Cozy Inside
guide.bakery.cozy_decor.text: Loveseats and macaron poufs to sit on, plushies, a heart mirror, a neon heart, tea sets, cake shelves, lace curtains, a pastel register and a tip jar.
guide.bakery.outdoor.title: Pretty Outside
guide.bakery.outdoor.text: Parasol tables, pastel benches, a pink picket fence, heart lamp posts, flower boxes, a bunny statue, a mailbox, a pastry cart and a welcome mat.
